mapper.select: SELECT lc.id, lc.user_id, lc.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, cc.logo_url AS card_company_logo_url, lc.card_number, lc.card_name, lc.card_classification, lc.card_type, lc.is_linked FROM linkable_cards lc JOIN card_companies cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND ( lc.is_linked = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cards c WHERE c.user_id = lc.user_id AND c.card_number = lc.card_number AND c.is_deleted = 1 ) )

SELECT lc.id, lc.user_id, lc.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, cc.logo_url AS card_company_logo_url, lc.card_number, lc.card_name, lc.card_classification, lc.card_type, lc.is_linked FROM linkable_cards lc JOIN card_companies cc ON lc.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE lc.id = #{linkableCardId} AND lc.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, c.card_name, c.card_number, c.card_classification, c.card_type, c.is_primary, c.is_agreed, c.created_at, c.is_deleted, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at FROM cards c JOIN card_companies cc ON c.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.card_number = #{cardNumber} AND c.is_deleted = 1

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, c.card_name, c.card_number, c.card_classification, c.card_type, c.is_primary, c.is_agreed, c.created_at, c.is_deleted, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at FROM cards c JOIN card_companies cc ON c.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.is_primary DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, c.card_name, c.card_number, c.card_classification, c.card_type, c.is_primary, c.is_agreed, c.created_at, c.is_deleted, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at FROM cards c JOIN card_companies cc ON c.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.is_deleted ASC, c.is_primary DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.card_company_code, cc.name AS card_company_name, c.card_name, c.card_number, c.card_classification, c.card_type, c.is_primary, c.is_agreed, c.created_at, c.is_deleted, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at FROM cards c JOIN card_companies cc ON c.card_company_code = cc.code WHERE c.id = #{cardId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cards ( user_id, card_company_code, card_name, card_number, card_classification, card_type, is_primary, is_agreed, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{cardCompanyCode}, #{cardName}, #{cardNumber}, #{cardClassification}, #{cardType}, #{isPrimary}, 1, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE cards SET is_primary = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_primary = 1
